parts.name: Root
parts.description: The open state, the delays and the interaction with the trigger. It renders no element.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable id, from which the component makes the id of the content. Give one on a server.

props.name: open
props.description: The open state. By default it goes in the two directions: use `bind:open`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state at the start, for when you give no `open`.

props.name: controlledOpen
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the open state. The component stops to write back to
`open`, and it reports only through `onOpenChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change: the
parent does not send the new value down. The default is off, because `bind:open` is the usual
case and it needs the write-back.

To refuse one change, use `details.cancel()`. That function works in the two modes.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The component calls it when the open state changes.

props.name: delay
props.description:
The milliseconds between the pointer and the open. The default is 600, or the value of the
`Tooltip.Provider`. A keyboard focus opens at once.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description:
The milliseconds between the pointer leaving and the close. The pointer can cross to the
content in that time, and the content then keeps the tooltip open. The default is 100, or the
value of the `Tooltip.Provider`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the tooltip: it does not open.

props.name: openOnLongPress
props.description:
Opens the tooltip on a long press of a touch or a pen, because a touch has no hover. It then
stays open until a press somewhere else, a tap on the trigger, or Escape. Set it to `false`
on a control where a long press has a meaning of its own, such as a text selection.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description:
The reference to the trigger element. Set it in your own code for an element that is not a
`Tooltip.Trigger`, or let `Tooltip.Trigger` set it.

props.name: children
props.description: The children: the Trigger and the Content.

props.name: context
props.description: A bindable reference to the context, for a composition of your own.

parts.name: Provider
parts.description: The delays of every tooltip inside it. It renders no element.

props.name: delay
props.description: The milliseconds between the pointer and the open, for every tooltip inside.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: The milliseconds between the pointer leaving and the close, for every tooltip inside.

props.name: skipDelay
props.description: The milliseconds after a close in which the next tooltip opens at once. The default is 300.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: The button that the tooltip describes. It renders a native button, and it points at the content with aria-describedby while the content is in the DOM.

props.name: children
props.description: The content. As a snippet with one argument, it receives the render state: `open`.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the button.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the button element.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The ids of other elements that describe the button. The tooltip adds its own while open.

parts.name: Content
parts.description: The floating panel with the description. It renders a div with role="tooltip" in a portal, positioned against the trigger.

props.name: offset
props.description: The distance from the trigger, on the main axis. The default is 8.

props.name: placement
props.description: The position against the trigger. The default is `top`.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description: Moves the panel to the opposite side when the space is not sufficient.

props.name: boundaryElement
props.description: The element that gives the limits of the position.

props.name: followPointer
props.description:
Moves the panel with the pointer along one axis, or both, in place of a fixed position
against the trigger. For a wide trigger, `x` keeps the panel above the pointer. A tooltip
that a keyboard focus opened stays against the trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: The content.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the panel.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the panel element.

dataAttributes.name: data-entering
dataAttributes.description: Present while the enter animation plays.

dataAttributes.name: data-exiting
dataAttributes.description: Present while the exit animation plays.

dataAttributes.name: data-placement
dataAttributes.description: The side of the trigger where the panel is: "top", "bottom", "left" or "right".

parts.name: Arrow
parts.description: The pointer of the panel toward the trigger. It renders a span, moved along the edge that faces the trigger.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the arrow.
